items.title: NVIDIA Data Breach Reportedly Exposes Personal Information of GeForce Users
items.description: A data breach at GFN.AM, an authorized NVIDIA GeForce NOW cloud gaming service provider operating under “GFN CLOUD INTERNET SERVICES” LLC, has exposed personal information belonging to registered users. items.title: Let’s Encrypt Halts Certificate Issuance After Cross-Signed Root Certificate Incident
items.description: Let’s Encrypt temporarily suspended all certificate issuance on May 8, 2026, after engineers identified a critical issue involving a cross-signed certificate linking the organization’s Generation X root to its upcoming Generation Y root infrastructure. items.title: Critical Microsoft 365 Copilot Vulnerabilities Expose sensitive Information
items.description: Microsoft has disclosed and fully remediated three critical information disclosure vulnerabilities affecting Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat in Microsoft Edge, all released on May 7, 2026, requiring no action from end users or administrators.
